observations.finding: 8/50 pathways significant (min q=0.002); top effects are up-regulation of HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE (SMD 1.12), INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE (1.02), ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION (0.96), IL6_JAK_STAT3 (0.93), COMPLEMENT (0.67), and down-regulation of WNT_BETA_CATENIN (-0.75).
BAP1 strongly enriched (50% vs 3.6%, OR 26.7, 95% CI 6.3-113.5, q=3.6e-5); PBRM1 depleted (15% vs 43.4%, OR 0.23, q=0.12); VHL lower (35% vs 59%, OR 0.37, q=0.31); TTN and SPTA1 nominal.
0/49 continuous features significant (min q=0.94); top effects higher PTEN and lower chr14q; gain/loss shows chr14q loss (60% vs 36%, OR 2.65, q=1.0) as top effect.

biological_support.statistical_interpretation: Coherent signal: significant immune/inflammatory (interferon, allograft, complement) up-regulation combined with a strong BAP1 mutation enrichment and PBRM1 depletion. CNV is largely non-informative.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: C0005 shows an immune/inflammatory-high expression program with a BAP1-mutant, PBRM1-low genomic background. This is a biologically coherent set identity.
limitations: CNV characterization is non-significant.
Analyses are relative to the rest of the partition.

limitations: Resampling used the existing SNF affinity subgraph.

limitations: Very small set size (n=5) limits power and estimability.
